news.headline_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期人乳头瘤病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 两项研究调查了女性对 HPV 自我采样检测的反应。两项研究都发现,相比临床医生的检测,女性更喜欢自行收集。新加坡的研究发表在《家庭医学年鉴》上,美国的研究发表在《JAMA Network Open》上。 [news-d6f07b3c1cd4d566]
德里高等法院拒绝临时中止印度的 HPV 疫苗接种 活动,允许该活动继续进行,同时有关知情同意、安全证据和监测的问题仍在审查中。 [news-13c1364a1115a149]
新加坡的一项实用随机对照试验测试了提供自行收集的 HPV 样本以及临床医生收集的样本是否会提高 宫颈癌 筛查参与度和 HPV 检出率。干预组首先接受临床医生采样,如果拒绝则自行采样,而常规护理组仅接受临床医生采样。 [news-2f374687b3af323c]
Seegene 宣布推出一种基于综合征 PCR 的生殖道感染 (RTI) 综合检测方法,可同时检测 STI 和 HPV。在此之前,全球百万临床研究于 2026 年 7 月 8 日启动。该公告基于对 60,000 项检测结果的分析,并作为支持 PCR 检测全球新标准的科学证据。 [news-aee0b2bb80d73752]
已确认:宫颈癌 是泰国女性中最常诊断出的癌症,每年报告新增病例超过 6,000 例,死亡人数约为 2,600 人。通过医学筛查及早发现,这种疾病是可以预防的。 [news-65c5365a66279131]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Human papillomaviruses news developments.
key_findings_en: Two studies examined women's response to HPV self-sampling testing. Both studies found that when offered, women prefer self-collection over clinician testing. The Singapore study was published in the Annals of Family Medicine, and the U.S. study was published in JAMA Network Open. [news-d6f07b3c1cd4d566]

The Delhi High Court declined to grant an interim stay on India’s HPV vaccination campaign, allowing it to continue while questions about informed consent, safety evidence, and monitoring remain under examination. [news-13c1364a1115a149]

A pragmatic randomized controlled trial in Singapore tested whether offering self-collected HPV samples alongside clinician-collected specimens would improve cervical cancer screening participation and HPV detection rates. [news-2f374687b3af323c]

Seegene announced a comprehensive syndromic PCR-based testing approach for reproductive tract infections (RTIs), detecting both STIs and HPV simultaneously. This follows the launch of the Global Million Clinical Study on 8 July 2026. [news-aee0b2bb80d73752]

Confirmed: Cervical cancer is the most frequently diagnosed cancer among women in Thailand, with over 6,000 new cases and approximately 2,600 fatalities reported annually. The disease is preventable through early detection via medical screenings. [news-65c5365a66279131]

papers.title: HPV18-Positive Cervical Large Cell Neuroendocrine Carcinoma With Rapid Progression Despite Pembrolizumab Combined With Chemotherapy: A Case Report With Immunogenomic Insights.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT HPV18‐positive cervical large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (LCNEC) is exceptionally rare. We report a 40‐years‐old woman with FIGO 2018 stage IVB LCNEC who progressed rapidly despite paclitaxel–carboplatin–bevacizumab plus pembrolizumab, followed by concurrent chemoradiotherapy and later cytotoxic regimens. Biopsy showed chromogranin A and synaptophysin positivity, diffuse p16, and Ki‐67%~80%. Comprehensive profiling revealed very low tumor mutational burden (TMB, 1.21/Mb), microsatellite stability, no homologous recombination deficiency, and minimal PD‐L1 (~1%), consistent with a poorly immunogenic tumor microenvironment (TME). This profile may explain the limited effect of immune checkpoint inhibition in this histology. The case suggests that HPV or p16 positivity alone did not predict clinical benefit from pembrolizumab‐based therapy in advanced cervical LCNEC, and supports careful biological assessment before treatment selection. These observations provide practical guidance for clinicians and support evaluation of alternative or investigational strategies for this aggressive tumor.
papers.journal: The journal of obstetrics and gynaecology research

papers.title: Exploration of immune correlates of viral clearance after PVX2 immunotherapy in patients with human papillomavirus type 16 infection and cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade ≤1.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Immune responses correlated with clearance of human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16) were sought in PVX2 immunotherapy-treated CIN ≤1 patients. PVX2 comprises intramuscular vaccinations with HPV16 E7-targeted pNGVL4a-Sig/E7(detox)/HSP70 DNA vaccine (3 mg, weeks 0 and 4) and HPV16 L2E7E6 fusion protein (TA-CIN; 100 μg week 8). Administering PVX2 to 12 women with HPV16+ CIN ≤1 elicited both antibody and CD8+ T-cell responses, including changes in TCR diversity, clonal expansion, and emergence of public clonotypes. HPV16 was not detected in 5/11 evaluable participants at month 6. Post-vaccination E6, E7, and L2-specific antibody titers were higher, but none correlated with clearance. Neither TCR clonal diversity/expansion nor public clonotypes were associated with HPV16 clearance. While the fractions of expanded/new clonotypes were not associated with HPV16 clearance, a higher proportion of vaccine antigen-specific reads was evident post-vaccination in those clearing HPV16. High baseline serum MCP-1 associated with HPV16 persistence, and MIP-1β trended higher post-vaccination in those clearing HPV16. IMPORTANCE HPV16 is a necessary cause of over half of all cervical cancers, and in even higher fractions of other anogenital and oropharyngeal cancers. Treatments for HPV16 infection and associated pre-cancerous lesions are needed given the disease burden and limitations of current treatments. Women with persistent HPV infections endure anxiety and stress due to frequent colposcopies, inconvenience, healthcare costs from active surveillance, and potential to transmit the virus to other sexual partners. Since a majority of patients can spontaneously clear their infections, administration of an immunotherapy may promote the elimination of otherwise persistent infections where disease can progress.

PVX2 comprises intramuscular vaccinations with HPV16 E7-targeted pNGVL4a-Sig/E7(detox)/HSP70 DNA vaccine (3 mg, weeks 0 and 4) and HPV16 L2E7E6 fusion protein (TA-CIN; 100 μg week 8). Administering PVX2 to 12 women with HPV16+ CIN ≤1 elicited both antibody and CD8+ T-cell responses, including changes in TCR diversity, clonal expansion, and emergence of public clonotypes. HPV16 was not detected in 5/11 evaluable participants at month 6. Post-vaccination E6, E7, and L2-specific antibody titers were higher, but none correlated with clearance. Neither TCR clonal diversity/expansion nor public clonotypes were associated with HPV16 clearance. While the fractions of expanded/new clonotypes were not associated with HPV16 clearance, a higher proportion of vaccine antigen-specific reads was evident post-vaccination in those clearing HPV16. High baseline serum MCP-1 associated with HPV16 persistence, and MIP-1β trended higher post-vaccination in those clearing HPV16.IMPORTANCEHPV16 is a necessary cause of over half of all cervical cancers, and in even higher fractions of other anogenital and oropharyngeal cancers. Treatments for HPV16 infection and associated pre-cancerous lesions are needed given the disease burden and limitations of current treatments. Women with persistent HPV infections endure anxiety and stress due to frequent colposcopies, inconvenience, healthcare costs from active surveillance, and potential to transmit the virus to other sexual partners. Since a majority of patients can spontaneously clear their infections, administration of an immunotherapy may promote the elimination of otherwise persistent infections where disease can progress.

papers.title_original: Exploration of immune correlates of viral clearance after PVX2 immunotherapy in patients with human papillomavirus type 16 infection and cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade ≤1.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to identify immune correlates of viral clearance after PVX2 immunotherapy in patients with HPV16 infection and cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade ≤1, addressing the need for better treatments given the limitations of current options and the anxiety caused by persistent infections.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A study was conducted in 12 women with HPV16-positive CIN ≤1, who received PVX2 immunotherapy comprising intramuscular vaccinations with HPV16 E7-targeted DNA vaccine and HPV16 L2E7E6 fusion protein.
analysis.methods: The study evaluated immune responses including antibody titers, CD8+ T-cell responses, TCR diversity, clonal expansion, and public clonotypes, as well as serum cytokine levels before and after vaccination.
analysis.main_results: HPV16 was not detected in 5/11 evaluable participants at month 6; post-vaccination E6, E7, and L2-specific antibody titers were higher but did not correlate with clearance, and neither TCR clonal diversity/expansion nor public clonotypes were associated with clearance.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that while immune responses were elicited, only a higher proportion of vaccine antigen-specific reads post-vaccination was associated with clearance, suggesting a potential novel correlate of protection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform the development of immunotherapies for persistent HPV16 infections by highlighting the importance of vaccine antigen-specific T-cell responses, potentially reducing the need for invasive procedures and transmission risks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the small sample size (n=12) and limited follow-up, though the study provides direct immune response measurements and viral clearance data.

analysis.summary_en: This study explored immune correlates of viral clearance after PVX2 immunotherapy in 12 women with HPV16-positive CIN ≤1. The PVX2 regimen included HPV16 E7-targeted DNA vaccine and L2E7E6 fusion protein. While HPV16 clearance was observed in 5/11 participants at month 6, neither antibody titers nor TCR clonal diversity/expansion correlated with clearance. However, a higher proportion of vaccine antigen-specific reads post-vaccination was associated with clearance, and high baseline serum MCP-1 was linked to persistence. The findings suggest vaccine-specific T-cell responses may be key to clearance, offering insights for improving immunotherapies against persistent HPV16 infections.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在确定 HPV16 感染和宫颈上皮内瘤变 ≤1 级患者在 PVX2 免疫治疗后病毒清除的免疫相关性,考虑到当前选择的局限性和持续感染引起的焦虑,解决对更好的 治疗 的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项研究对 12 名 HPV16 阳性 CIN ≤1 的女性进行了研究,她们接受了 PVX2 免疫疗法,其中包括肌肉注射 疫苗接种、HPV16 E7 靶向 DNA 疫苗 和 HPV16 L2E7E6 融合蛋白。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究评估了 免疫应答,包括抗体滴度、CD8+ T 细胞反应、TCR 多样性、克隆扩增和公共克隆型,以及 疫苗接种 前后的血清细胞因子水平。
elements_zh.main_results: 第 6 个月时,5/11 的可评估参与者中未检测到 HPV16;疫苗接种 后 E6、E7 和 L2 特异性抗体滴度较高,但与清除率无关,并且 TCR 克隆多样性/扩展和公共克隆型均与清除率无关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,虽然引发了 免疫应答,但在 疫苗接种 后只有较高比例的 疫苗 抗原特异性读数与清除相关,这表明潜在的新型保护相关性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能通过强调 疫苗 抗原特异性 T 细胞反应的重要性,为持续性 HPV16 感染的免疫疗法的开发提供信息,从而有可能减少侵入性手术的需要和 传播 风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管该研究提供了直接的 免疫应答 测量和病毒清除数据,但由于样本量较小 (n=12) 和有限的随访,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 在 PVX2 免疫治疗治疗的 CIN ≤ 1 例患者中寻找与 人乳头瘤病毒 16 型 (HPV16) 清除率相关的 免疫应答。PVX2 包含肌肉注射 疫苗接种,其中含有 HPV16 E7 靶向 pNGVL4a-Sig/E7(detox)/HSP70 DNA 疫苗(3 mg,第 0 周和第 4 周)和 HPV16 L2E7E6 融合蛋白(TA-CIN;100 μg 第 8 周)。对 12 名 HPV16+ CIN ≤1 的女性施用 PVX2 引发了抗体和 CD8+ T 细胞反应,包括 TCR 多样性的变化、克隆扩张和公共克隆型的出现。第 6 个月时,5/11 名可评估参与者中未检测到 HPV16。疫苗接种 后 E6、E7 和 L2 特异性抗体滴度较高,但与清除率无关。TCR 克隆多样性/扩增和公共克隆型均与 HPV16 清除无关。虽然扩展/新克隆型的分数与 HPV16 清除无关,但在那些清除 HPV16 的人中,疫苗 抗原特异性读数在 疫苗接种 后的比例明显较高。高基线血清 MCP-1 与 HPV16 持续存在相关,而在清除 HPV16 的患者中,疫苗接种 后 MIP-1β 呈较高趋势。重要性 HPV16 是超过一半的 宫颈癌 的必要原因,在其他肛门生殖器和口咽癌中的比例甚至更高。考虑到当前 治疗 的疾病负担和局限性,需要针对 HPV16 感染和相关癌前病变的 治疗。持续感染 HPV 的女性由于频繁进行阴道镜检查、不便、主动 监测 带来的医疗费用以及将病毒传播给其他性伴侣的可能性而承受着焦虑和压力。由于大多数患者可以自发清除感染,因此免疫治疗可以促进消除疾病可能进展的持续性感染。

analysis_zh.methods: 该研究评估了 免疫应答,包括抗体滴度、CD8+ T 细胞反应、TCR 多样性、克隆扩增和公共克隆型,以及 疫苗接种 前后的血清细胞因子水平。
analysis_zh.main_results: 第 6 个月时,5/11 的可评估参与者中未检测到 HPV16;疫苗接种 后 E6、E7 和 L2 特异性抗体滴度较高,但与清除率无关,并且 TCR 克隆多样性/扩展和公共克隆型均与清除率无关。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,虽然引发了 免疫应答,但在 疫苗接种 后只有较高比例的 疫苗 抗原特异性读数与清除相关,这表明潜在的新型保护相关性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能通过强调 疫苗 抗原特异性 T 细胞反应的重要性,为持续性 HPV16 感染的免疫疗法的开发提供信息,从而有可能减少侵入性手术的需要和 传播 风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管该研究提供了直接的 免疫应答 测量和病毒清除数据,但由于样本量较小 (n=12) 和有限的随访,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Baseline characteristics of the HOMINY (human papillomavirus, human immunodeficiency virus, and oral microbiota interplay in Nigerian youth) prospective longitudinal cohort
papers.abstract: Background The HOMINY (Human Papillomavirus, Human Immunodeficiency Virus, and Oral Microbiota Interplay in Nigerian Youth) cohort is a prospective longitudinal study established to investigate oral HPV infection and the oral microbiome among mother-child pairs with and without HIV in Nigeria. The objective of this analysis was to describe baseline demographic and clinical characteristics of the cohort, including HPV awareness, HPV vaccination, and cervical cancer screening practice by HIV status. Method Mothers (aged ≥ 18) and children (aged 9–18) were prospectively enrolled at the University of Benin Teaching Hospital. Participants were grouped by HIV infection and exposure status. Baseline demographic, behavioral, and HPV-related data were collected using standardized questionnaires, medical record review, and case report forms. Group differences were assessed using parametric and non-parametric tests. Results A total of 1,075 participants were enrolled. Among mothers, 68% were HIV-positive. Awareness of HPV (<7%) and the HPV vaccine (3.0%) was low with fewer than 1% having received HPV vaccination, and only 19.1% reported ever undergoing cervical cancer screening. Mothers living with HIV reported younger age at sexual debut, more lifetime sexual partners, and lower education attainment than HIV-uninfected mothers. Among children, awareness of HPV and the HPV vaccine was virtually absent, and only one child reported HPV vaccination. Birth characteristics differed by HIV status, with Caesarian sections and other perinatal exposures being higher among HIV-exposed groups. Conclusion Baseline findings demonstrate substantial gaps in HPV awareness, vaccination, and cervical cancer screening among families affected by HIV before implementation of Nigeria's national HPV vaccination program. This highlights critical prevention gaps and sustained cancer risk, underscoring urgent needs for targeted HPV and HIV prevention in Nigerian youth. As the largest prospective mother-child cohort focused on oral HPV and HIV in sub-Saharan Africa, HOMINY provides an important foundation for future longitudinal studies of oral HPV infection, the oral microbiome, and the impact of HPV vaccination.

analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a prospective longitudinal study conducted at the University of Benin Teaching Hospital, enrolling mothers (aged ≥18) and children (aged 9–18). Participants were grouped by HIV infection and exposure status. Baseline data were collected using standardized questionnaires, medical record review, and case report forms, with group differences assessed using parametric and non-parametric tests.

analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study highlights critical prevention gaps and sustained cancer risk but does not address mechanisms of HPV transmission or long-term outcomes. The study underscores urgent needs for targeted HPV/HIV prevention and highlights the cohort's value for future longitudinal research on oral HPV and vaccination impact.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: HOMINY 前瞻性纵向 队列研究 研究调查了尼日利亚感染和未感染 HIV 的母子对的口腔 HPV 感染和口腔微生物组,重点关注 HPV 认知、疫苗接种 和按 HIV 状况划分的 宫颈癌 筛查实践。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是一项在贝宁大学教学医院进行的前瞻性纵向研究,招募了母亲(≥18 岁)和儿童(9-18 岁)。参与者根据艾滋病毒感染和暴露状况进行分组。使用标准化问卷、病历审查和 病例报告 表格收集基线数据,并使用参数和非参数检验评估组间差异。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 基线结果显示,HPV 知晓率 (<7%)、HPV 疫苗接种(知晓率 3.0%,疫苗接种率 <1%)和 宫颈癌 筛查(母亲中 19.1%)存在巨大差距。与未感染艾滋病毒的母亲相比,感染艾滋病毒的母亲报告首次性行为更早,终生性伴侣更多,受教育程度较低。儿童几乎没有 HPV 意识或 疫苗接种。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究强调了关键的预防差距和持续的癌症风险,但没有解决 HPV 传播 的机制或长期结果。值得注意的是,有关 HPV 特定类型及其与该人群口腔微生物组动态的关联的数据有限。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 尼日利亚青年迫切需要制定有针对性的 HPV 和 HIV 预防策略,特别是解决认识不足和 疫苗接种 率的问题。HOMINY 队列研究 为未来口腔 HPV 感染、口腔微生物组和 HPV 疫苗接种 影响的纵向研究奠定了基础。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The HOMINY prospective longitudinal cohort study investigates oral HPV infection and the oral microbiome among mother-child pairs with and without HIV in Nigeria, focusing on HPV awareness, vaccination, and cervical cancer screening practices by HIV status.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a prospective longitudinal study conducted at the University of Benin Teaching Hospital, enrolling mothers (aged ≥18) and children (aged 9–18). Participants were grouped by HIV infection and exposure status. Baseline data were collected using standardized questionnaires, medical record review, and case report forms, with group differences assessed using parametric and non-parametric tests.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Baseline findings reveal substantial gaps in HPV awareness (<7%), HPV vaccination (3.0% awareness, <1% vaccinated), and cervical cancer screening (19.1% among mothers). analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study highlights critical prevention gaps and sustained cancer risk but does not address mechanisms of HPV transmission or long-term outcomes. analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: There is an urgent need for targeted HPV and HIV prevention strategies in Nigerian youth, particularly addressing low awareness and vaccination rates. papers.title_zh: HOMINY(人乳头瘤病毒、人类免疫缺陷病毒和尼日利亚青年口腔微生物群相互作用)的基线特征前瞻性纵向 队列研究
papers.source_body_en: Background The HOMINY (Human Papillomavirus, Human Immunodeficiency Virus, and Oral Microbiota Interplay in Nigerian Youth) cohort is a prospective longitudinal study established to investigate oral HPV infection and the oral microbiome among mother-child pairs with and without HIV in Nigeria. The objective of this analysis was to describe baseline demographic and clinical characteristics of the cohort, including HPV awareness, HPV vaccination, and cervical cancer screening practice by HIV status. Method Mothers (aged ≥ 18) and children (aged 9–18) were prospectively enrolled at the University of Benin Teaching Hospital. Participants were grouped by HIV infection and exposure status. Baseline demographic, behavioral, and HPV-related data were collected using standardized questionnaires, medical record review, and case report forms. Group differences were assessed using parametric and non-parametric tests. Results A total of 1,075 participants were enrolled. Among mothers, 68% were HIV-positive. Awareness of HPV (<7%) and the HPV vaccine (3.0%) was low with fewer than 1% having received HPV vaccination, and only 19.1% reported ever undergoing cervical cancer screening. Mothers living with HIV reported younger age at sexual debut, more lifetime sexual partners, and lower education attainment than HIV-uninfected mothers. Among children, awareness of HPV and the HPV vaccine was virtually absent, and only one child reported HPV vaccination. Birth characteristics differed by HIV status, with Caesarian sections and other perinatal exposures being higher among HIV-exposed groups. Conclusion Baseline findings demonstrate substantial gaps in HPV awareness, vaccination, and cervical cancer screening among families affected by HIV before implementation of Nigeria's national HPV vaccination program. This highlights critical prevention gaps and sustained cancer risk, underscoring urgent needs for targeted HPV and HIV prevention in Nigerian youth. As the largest prospective mother-child cohort focused on oral HPV and HIV in sub-Saharan Africa, HOMINY provides an important foundation for future longitudinal studies of oral HPV infection, the oral microbiome, and the impact of HPV vaccination.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 HOMINY(人乳头瘤病毒,尼日利亚青少年中的人类免疫缺陷病毒和口腔微生物群的相互作用)队列研究 是一项前瞻性纵向研究,旨在调查尼日利亚感染和未感染 HIV 的母子对的口腔 HPV 感染和口腔微生物组。本分析的目的是描述 队列研究 的基线人口统计和临床特征,包括 HPV 认知、HPV 疫苗接种 和按 HIV 状态划分的 宫颈癌 筛查实践。方法 贝宁大学教学医院前瞻性招募母亲(≥ 18 岁)和儿童(9-18 岁)。参与者根据艾滋病毒感染和暴露状况进行分组。使用标准化问卷、病历审查和 病例报告 表格收集基线人口统计、行为和 HPV 相关数据。使用参数和非参数检验评估组间差异。结果 共有 1,075 名参与者入组。在母亲中,68% 的人艾滋病毒呈阳性。对 HPV (<7%) 和 HPV 疫苗 (3.0%) 的认知度较低,不到 1% 的人接受过 HPV 疫苗接种,并且只有 19.1% 的人报告曾接受过 宫颈癌 筛查。与未感染艾滋病毒的母亲相比,感染艾滋病毒的母亲首次性行为的年龄更小,终身性伴侣更多,受教育程度更低。在儿童中,对 HPV 和 HPV 疫苗 的认识几乎不存在,只有一名儿童报告了 HPV 疫苗接种。出生特征因艾滋病毒感染状况而异,剖腹产和其他围产期暴露在艾滋病毒暴露群体中较高。结论 基线结果表明,在实施尼日利亚国家 HPV 疫苗接种 计划之前,受 HIV 影响的家庭在 HPV 认识、疫苗接种 和 宫颈癌 筛查方面存在巨大差距。这突显了关键的预防差距和持续的癌症风险,凸显了尼日利亚青年迫切需要有针对性的 HPV 和 HIV 预防。作为撒哈拉以南非洲最大的专注于口腔 HPV 和 HIV 的前瞻性母子 队列研究,HOMINY 为未来口腔 HPV 感染、口腔微生物组和 HPV 疫苗接种 影响的纵向研究提供了重要基础。

papers.title: Gynaecologists' Views and Acceptability of Active Surveillance for Women Diagnosed With Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia 2: A Qualitative Study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Persistent oncogenic HPV infection can cause cervical epithelial changes leading to premalignant lesions such as CIN2. Active surveillance, a conservative option, reduces exposure to excisional risks while allowing timely treatment when needed. However, little is known about clinicians' perspectives, acceptability, and experience of offering active surveillance in the Australian healthcare context. AIMS: To explore gynaecologists' perspectives, acceptability, and experiences in providing active surveillance to women diagnosed with CIN2. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Individual semi-structured interviews were conducted with obstetrics and gynaecology specialists and trainees in secondary and tertiary healthcare settings across Australia. Data were analysed using inductive thematic analysis. RESULTS: Twenty-five in-depth interviews were conducted. Participants expressed positive views about active surveillance, regarding it as a safe option that does not increase long-term cancer risk. When formulating management recommendations for CIN2, participants considered various interrelated diagnostic, patient, clinician, and policy-level factors. To support shared decision-making, participants used several communication strategies such as anatomical models and visual images to help address patient knowledge gaps and they provided patients with time and space to reflect on their preferred management plan. Participants identified strategies that could support offering active surveillance and patients' adherence to this, including enhanced clinician education and training, increased resourcing, and improved use of information technology to support follow-up tests for active surveillance. CONCLUSIONS: A deeper understanding of multi-level factors influencing clinicians' recommendations and implementation of active surveillance for CIN2 may inform the development of targeted interventions to address barriers and strengthen enablers, ultimately supporting wider offering of active surveillance.

To support shared decision-making, participants used several communication strategies such as anatomical models and visual images to help address patient knowledge gaps and they provided patients with time and space to reflect on their preferred management plan. Participants identified strategies that could support offering active surveillance and patients' adherence to this, including enhanced clinician education and training, increased resourcing, and improved use of information technology to support follow-up tests for active surveillance. papers.title: Changing burden of cancers related to human papillomavirus in Estonia: a population-based registry study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Human papillomavirus (HPV) causes multiple cancers. Understanding HPV-related cancer burden may help implement effective strategies for cancer prevention. The aim was to examine incidence and survival trends of eight HPV-related cancer sites in Estonia and estimate the number of cases attributable to HPV. Patient/material and methods: The Estonian Cancer Registry provided data on all cases of eight HPV-related cancer sites diagnosed in Estonia during 1995-2022. Age-standardized incidence trends were analyzed using joinpoint regression, estimating annual percentage change (APC). The number of HPV-attributable cases was estimated using internationally derived site-specific attributable fractions, as tumor HPV status was not available. Five-year relative survival ratios were calculated from national life tables. RESULTS: In all, 11,266 cases of HPV-related cancer sites were diagnosed, of which 6,263 were estimated to be attributable to HPV; over 40% occurred before age 55. In women, estimated average annual number of HPV-attributable cases nearly quadrupled for oropharyngeal cancer (OPC) and tripled for anal cancer. A significant increase in OPC and anal cancer incidence was observed among women (APC 10.0 and 3.8, respectively). Cervical cancer incidence declined after 2012 (APC -5.6). Survival improved for OPC in men (from 13 to 44%) and vaginal cancer in women (from 45 to 73%). INTERPRETATION: HPV-related cancer patterns in Estonia are shifting from cervical to non-cervical cancers. Increasing oropharyngeal and anal cancer incidence highlights the need for prevention strategies beyond cervical screening alone. Strengthening HPV vaccination uptake and sustaining organized cervical screening are critical for reducing future cancer burden.

papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Human papillomavirus (HPV) causes multiple cancers. Understanding HPV-related cancer burden may help implement effective strategies for cancer prevention. The aim was to examine incidence and survival trends of eight HPV-related cancer sites in Estonia and estimate the number of cases attributable to HPV. Patient/material and methods: The Estonian Cancer Registry provided data on all cases of eight HPV-related cancer sites diagnosed in Estonia during 1995-2022. Age-standardized incidence trends were analyzed using joinpoint regression, estimating annual percentage change (APC). The number of HPV-attributable cases was estimated using internationally derived site-specific attributable fractions, as tumor HPV status was not available. Five-year relative survival ratios were calculated from national life tables. RESULTS: In all, 11,266 cases of HPV-related cancer sites were diagnosed, of which 6,263 were estimated to be attributable to HPV; over 40% occurred before age 55. In women, estimated average annual number of HPV-attributable cases nearly quadrupled for oropharyngeal cancer (OPC) and tripled for anal cancer. A significant increase in OPC and anal cancer incidence was observed among women (APC 10.0 and 3.8, respectively). Cervical cancer incidence declined after 2012 (APC -5.6). Survival improved for OPC in men (from 13 to 44%) and vaginal cancer in women (from 45 to 73%). INTERPRETATION: HPV-related cancer patterns in Estonia are shifting from cervical to non-cervical cancers. Increasing oropharyngeal and anal cancer incidence highlights the need for prevention strategies beyond cervical screening alone. Strengthening HPV vaccination uptake and sustaining organized cervical screening are critical for reducing future cancer burden.

papers.title: Women's experiences, responses, and coping strategies when testing positive for human papillomavirus in cervical cancer screening: A qualitative study.
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Many countries, including Denmark, are adopting human papillomavirus‐based cervical screening due to its higher sensitivity compared to cytology. However, the sexually transmitted nature of HPV may evoke psychosexual distress. We aimed to explore: (1) women's psychosexual experiences, and (2) factors that shape their experiences and coping strategies in relation to routine cervical cancer screening. Material and Methods We conducted a qualitative study at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Gødstrup Hospital, Denmark from September 2024 to February 2025. We included women aged 30–60 referred to colposcopy due to a high‐risk HPV‐positive screening. Women were excluded if they had a previous history of excisional treatment. We conducted in‐depth semi‐structured interviews. All interviews were audiotaped and transcribed verbatim, after which a thematic analysis was performed using a phenomenological approach. Results We included 21 women with a median age of 42.5 years (range: 32–55 years). Receiving a high‐risk HPV result by mail left women without immediate support or information, causing feelings of anxiety about cancer risk, confusion about their health and next steps in treatment. The general practitioner (GP) was perceived as a source of reassurance, but was not always easily accessible. Recognizing the impact of HPV as a sexually transmitted virus triggered feelings of guilt, shame, and embarrassment, as well as sensations of uncleanliness and bodily disconnection. The diagnosis also strained relationships and disrupted sexual intimacy. Although the follow‐up gynecological consultation with colposcopy was reassuring, it was experienced as complex due to emotional burdens such as stigma and shame. A sense of needing to simply “comply” also hindered open discussion about the sexual nature of HPV and the expression of personal concerns. Conclusions Based on a practice theoretical framework, this study shows that women's experiences following a high‐risk HPV diagnosis in the context of cervical screening are not merely individual responses to medical information, but should be understood within a broader psychological, social, and cultural context that shapes how women process and cope with the diagnosis. These findings underscore the need for a holistic approach to patient care that fosters supportive and informative practices for women affected by HPV, coupled with a broader societal effort to reduce stigma and increase public awareness.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 简介 包括丹麦在内的许多国家正在采用基于 人乳头瘤病毒 的宫颈筛查,因为其敏感性比细胞学检查更高。然而,HPV 的性传播性质可能会引起性心理困扰。我们的目的是探索:(1) 女性的性心理经历,以及 (2) 影响她们经历的因素以及与常规 宫颈癌 筛查相关的应对策略。材料和方法 我们于 2024 年 9 月至 2025 年 2 月在丹麦 Gødstrup 医院妇产科进行了一项定性研究。我们纳入了因高危 HPV 阳性筛查而转诊接受阴道镜检查的 30-60 岁女性。如果女性以前有 治疗 切除史,则被排除在外。我们进行了深入的半结构化访谈。所有访谈均被录音并逐字转录,然后使用现象学方法进行主题分析。结果 我们纳入了 21 名女性,平均年龄为 42.5 岁(范围:32-55 岁)。通过邮件收到高危 HPV 结果后,女性无法立即获得支持或信息,导致她们对癌症风险感到焦虑,对自己的健康状况和 治疗 的后续步骤感到困惑。全科医生 (GP) 被认为是令人安心的来源,但并不总是那么容易联系到。认识到 HPV 作为一种性传播病毒的影响会引发内疚、羞耻和尴尬的感觉,以及不清洁和身体脱节的感觉。诊断 还会使人际关系紧张并扰乱性亲密关系。尽管通过阴道镜进行的后续妇科会诊令人放心,但由于耻辱和羞耻等情感负担,整个过程变得复杂。简单地“遵守”的感觉也阻碍了关于 HPV 的性本质的公开讨论和个人担忧的表达。结论 基于实践理论框架,本研究表明,女性在宫颈筛查中感染高危 HPV 诊断 后的经历不仅仅是个人对医疗信息的反应,还应该在更广泛的心理、社会和文化背景下进行理解,这些背景塑造了女性如何处理和应对 诊断。这些发现强调需要采取整体的患者护理方法,为受 HPV 影响的女性提供支持和信息丰富的做法,同时还需要更广泛的社会努力来减少耻辱并提高公众意识。

analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于该研究的定性性质,并且排除了既往有 治疗 切除史的女性,因此证据强度中等,这可能会限制普遍性。

papers.title: Unveiling Optimal Cervical Cancer Screening Age Range: Study of HPV Infection Among 75,719 Women in Indonesia's Metropolitan Regions (2012 - 2022).
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the primary cause of cervical cancer, a global health crisis. Indonesia is placed as having the highest cervical cancer incidence and fatality in Southeast Asia. Currently, under the National Cervical Cancer Elimination (NCCE) plan, Indonesia has extended HPV DNA-based screening from 30-50 to 30-69 years old. However, various factors can lead to inadequate virus clearance in younger populations, and Indonesia has not yet had a large-scale analysis of age-specific HPV infection reports, leaving the ideal screening age uncertain. Therefore, this study aims to investigate age-specific HPV prevalence in Indonesia to inform the optimal age range for cervical cancer screening. METHODS: In this retrospective cross-sectional study, 75,719 subjects' data were utilized from all metropolitan regions in Indonesia from 2012-2020, who were tested with HPV DNA using PCR (SPF10-DEIA-LiPA25) and hybridization. The data were then analyzed by age and HPV genotype using IBM SPSS 27.0. RESULTS: 12.62% of 75,719 women aged 13-75 are HPV-positive. Women aged 30-39 (39.56%) and 40-49 (21.1%) had the highest infection rates, followed by 25-29 (18.9%) and those below 25 years (8.8%). This contrasts with the infection rates of women aged 60-65 (1.5%) and 66-69 (0.6%). Across all age categories, HPV52, HPV16, and HPV58 were the most prevalent high-risk genotypes, with substantial variations in infection rates (p <0.001). High-risk HPV outnumbered low-risk HPV in all age categories. CONCLUSION: HPV-positive prevalence in the younger population, particularly among those aged 25-29, is frequent in Indonesia. After age 65, HPV-positive cases drop significantly. Several variables contribute to this. This study recommends adjusting cervical cancer screening to Indonesian women aged 25-65.

papers.abstract_zh: 目标:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 是导致全球健康危机 宫颈癌 的主要原因。印度尼西亚被列为东南亚 宫颈癌 发病率 和死亡率最高的国家。目前,根据国家宫颈癌消除(NCCE)计划,印度尼西亚已将基于HPV DNA的筛查从30-50岁扩大到30-69岁。然而,多种因素可能导致较年轻人群的病毒清除不足,而且印度尼西亚尚未对特定年龄的HPV感染报告进行大规模分析,使得理想的筛查年龄不确定。因此,本研究旨在调查印度尼西亚的年龄特异性 HPV 患病率,以了解 宫颈癌 筛查的最佳年龄范围。方法:在这项回顾性横断面研究中,利用了 2012 年至 2020 年印度尼西亚所有大都市区的 75,719 名受试者的数据,通过 PCR (SPF10-DEIA-LiPA25) 和杂交对他们进行了 HPV DNA 检测。然后使用 IBM SPSS 27.0 按年龄和 HPV 基因型对数据进行分析。结果:75,719 名 13-75 岁女性中,12.62% HPV 阳性。30-39岁(39.56%)和40-49岁(21.1%)女性感染率最高,其次是25-29岁(18.9%)和25岁以下(8.8%)。这与 60-65 岁(1.5%)和 66-69 岁(0.6%)女性的感染率形成鲜明对比。在所有年龄组中,HPV52、HPV16 和 HPV58 是最常见的高危基因型,感染率差异很大 (p <0.001)。在所有年龄组中,高危型HPV 的数量都超过了低危 HPV。结论:HPV 阳性 患病率 在印度尼西亚的年轻人中,尤其是 25-29 岁的人群中很常见。65 岁以后,HPV 阳性病例显着下降。有几个变量促成了这一点。本研究建议调整 25-65 岁印度尼西亚女性的 宫颈癌 筛查。

papers.title: Attitudes and Knowledge About Human Papillomavirus and Cervical Cancer among Women Referred to a Tertiary Gynecologic Oncology Clinic, Tehran, Iran
papers.abstract: Background & Objective: Cervical cancer is a major public health concern worldwide. This study was conducted with aim to assess the attitudes and knowledge about Human Papillomavirus (HPV) and cervical cancer among women attending a tertiary gynecologic clinic.Materials & Methods: This descriptive, cross-sectional survey was conducted among 139 women referred to the gynecologic clinics of Yas Hospital Complex, affiliated with Tehran University of Medical Sciences, from 2023 to 2024. Data were collected through face-to-face interviews. Data analysis was performed using SPSS (IBM SPSS Statistics for Windows, Version 25). P<0.05 was considered statistically significant.Results: The mean total knowledge score was 25.07±5.92 out of a possible 33 points. Participants demonstrated strong foundational awareness, correctly identifying HPV as a sexually transmitted infection, recognizing that HPV affects both genders, and recognizing its role in causing cervical cancer. However, knowledge of the risks of vertical transmission and the lack of a specific antiviral treatment for HPV was low. Educational attainment was significantly associated with knowledge levels (P=0.01). Indeed, educational attainment was the strongest predictor of knowledge scores.Conclusion: In this clinical setting, basic HPV awareness was high among women. However, substantial misconceptions persisted regarding treatment options, vertical transmission, and vaccination efficacy. These findings highlight an urgent need for educational interventions targeting these knowledge gaps, particularly among women with lower educational attainment. They also underscore the need for structured HPV education and culturally tailored awareness campaigns.

Introduction Cervical cancer is a major public health concern worldwide. It is the fourth most common cancer among women globally. In 2020, about 604 new cases and 342 deaths per 1000 occurred worldwide. Over 85% of these deaths occur in low- and middle-income countries. Preventive strategies, such as Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination and regular screening, remain underused in these areas (1-4). Knowledge gaps and attitudinal barriers continue to impede the implementation of preventive strategies. Among women in Iran, cervical cancer is the tenth most frequent cancer. It is the seventh most common among women aged 15-44 years. There is a lack of a national HPV vaccination program in Iran. Routine cervical cancer screening with Pap smears is not available everywhere (5). Additional barriers include cultural sensitivities around Sexually Transmitted Infections (STIs) and limited public awareness of HPV. Since knowledge and attitudes directly affect screening behaviors and Elham Shirali, et al. 684 Volume 11, August 2026 Journal of Obstetrics, Gynecology and Cancer Research vaccine acceptance, these factors reduce uptake of preventive measures (6,7). Significant problems include misconceptions about HPV transmission, infection-related stigma, and poor understanding of disease progression. These barriers are particularly strong in conservative societies like Iran. HPV awareness among university students, healthcare workers, and women in urban screening centers has been the focus of previous Iranian research. Ghojazadeh et al., (8) found that although most participants had heard of HPV, medical students in Tabriz had limited detailed knowledge of its transmission and complications. Pooyanmehr and Sarmadi (9) reported similar results in Kermanshah province. Persistent misconceptions about HPV persisted even among educated youth. However, few studies have specifically examined knowledge and attitudes among women actively using gynecologic oncology services. This group is at higher risk for HPV- related diseases and may be undergoing diagnostic or screening procedures. Therefore, the present study was conducted with aims to assess the attitude and knowledge about HPV and cervical cancer among women referred to a gynecological oncology clinic. 2. Materials and Methods This descriptive, cross-sectional survey was conducted among 139 women referred to the gynecologic clinics of Yas Hospital Complex, affiliated with Tehran University of Medical Sciences, from 2023 to 2024. During clinic visits, we recruited participants using non-probability convenience sampling. Women with a prior history of treating cervical lesions (such as cervical surgery and medication), a current pregnancy, prior HPV vaccination, or reluctance to participate in the study were excluded from the study. The sample size was estimated as 139 subjects according to the values reported in Wright et al., (11), a power of 80%, a significance level of 0.05. Data were collected through face-to-face interviews. A structured, previously validated questionnaire was used. The validity and internal consistency of the questionnaire was confirmedas 0.79 by Mojahed et al., (10). Demographic variables (age, marital status, education level, gravidity, parity, smoking/hookah history, and contraceptive methods) were addressed in separate sections. HPV infection knowledge was also assessed. This included its effects on different genders, prevalence and sexual transmission, the role of condom use in decreasing transmission, vertical transmission from mother to baby, related diseases (genital warts and cervical cancer), and knowledge of available treatment and vaccination. Responses were used to assess overall awareness and attitude. Statistical Analysis The data were analyzed using SPSS (IBM SPSS Statistics for Windows, Version 25.0, Armonk, NY). Continuous variables were presented as means±standard deviations. Categorical variables were presented as frequencies and percentages. One-way Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) was used to compare knowledge scores across categorical variables (education level, marital status). Relationships between continuous variables (age, knowledge score) were assessed using the Pearson correlation coefficient. P<0.05 was considered statistically significant. 3. Results A total of 139 women participated in this study. The mean age of the participants was 36.92±10.00 years, with a range of 15 to 64 years. The largest group of participants (42.45%) held a bachelor's degree or higher. Most were married (69.8%), with a mean gravidity of 1.35±1.38 pregnancies. Most participants (65.5%) did not use contraception, while 23.7% used a condom. Smoking was reported by 10.1% of participants, and hookah use by 23.0%. The mean total knowledge score was 25.07±5.92 out of a maximum possible score of 33 points. Nearly all participants (92.8%) correctly identified HPV as a sexually transmitted infection. About 88% recognized that HPV infection affects both men and women. Knowledge of HPV's clinical implications was notably high. Most participants (83.5%) identified HPV as a cause of cervical cancer in women, and 84.9% knew of its association with genital warts. However, knowledge gaps were evident regarding vertical transmission. Only 42.4% were aware that HPV could be transmitted from mother to child during pregnancy or childbirth. Participants demonstrated a good understanding of prevention methods and risk factors. Most (76.3%) knew that condom use could reduce the risk of HPV transmission. Moreover, 90.6% correctly acknowledged that having multiple sexual partners increases the risk of infection. However, only 57.6% were aware that the early onset of sexual activity increases the risk of HPV infection. Knowledge of HPV treatment was limited. Only 31.7% correctly understood that no specific antiviral treatment exists for HPV infection. About 50% believed such treatment was available, an incorrect belief. Vaccination awareness was relatively high, with 86.3% agreeing that pre-sexual activity vaccination is preferable. However, only 54.0% believed that vaccination remains effective after sexual debut, while 36.0% were uncertain (Figure 1). Discussion The vast majority of participants demonstrated strong foundational HPV knowledge. Moreover, HPV was correctly identified as a sexually transmitted infection by 92.8%, and that it affects both men and women was recognized by 87.8%. These awareness levels are substantially higher than those reported in previous Iranian studies. In a study by Ghojazadeh et al., (8) among medical students in Tabriz found that 76% of students recognized STIs. Similar trends have been reported in international studies. Multiparous women demonstrate greater awareness of reproductive health risks. However, the non-significant association in our study indicates that healthcare providers should not assume that reproductive experience automatically confers HPV knowledge. Instead, these findings support the systematic integration of HPV education into routine maternal care visits (12). Behavioral risk factors revealed patterns linking lifestyle choices with deficits in health knowledge. In the present study, women with a smoking history (10.1%) and hookah use (23.0%) had lower HPV knowledge scores than non-users; however, the difference was not significant in our sample. This trend aligns with established research showing that tobacco users consistently have lower engagement with preventive health services and lower health literacy across multiple domains (13-15). Despite Iran's absence of a national HPV vaccination program, awareness regarding vaccination was high. The vaccine's preventive potential when administered before sexual debut was recognized by 86.3% of participants. This level of awareness suggests effective informal dissemination of health information. This may occur through healthcare providers, the media, or international health sources (16,17). An important association between protective behaviors and HPV knowledge was revealed by contraceptive use patterns. In the present study, women using barrier contraceptives, particularly condoms (23.7%), demonstrated slightly higher knowledge scores than non-users. That condom use reduces HPV transmission risk was correctly understood by 76.3%. This relationship between contraceptive choice and health knowledge likely reflects broader patterns of health-conscious behavior. Sexual health literacy and proactive healthcare engagement extend beyond contraception alone (18,19). However, a critical knowledge gap emerged regarding asymptomatic transmission dynamics. That HPV can be transmitted between carriers was correctly understood by 62.6% of participants in the current research. A concerning 38.8% misunderstood the potential for asymptomatic individuals to transmit the virus. About this mechanism, 30.9% were uncertain. This represents a fundamental misconception with significant implications for prevention behaviors. The majority of HPV infections are asymptomatic. Individuals may unknowingly transmit the virus to partners (20). This study's primary strength lies in its real-world clinical setting. It provides insights into HPV knowledge among women actively engaged in gynecologic care, a population at potentially heightened risk for HPV-related diseases. The use of a validated questionnaire and a comprehensive assessment of sociodemographic factors enhance the reliability and interpretability of the findings. However, several important limitations warrant consideration. The cross-sectional design precludes causal inferences about factors influencing HPV knowledge. Unicentric and the use of convenience sampling limit generalizability. 5. Conclusion Educational attainment emerged as the strongest predictor of HPV knowledge. Women with higher educational degrees scored 13-16% higher than those with a basic education. This underscores education's critical role in health literacy. These findings have immediate clinical implications for Iranian healthcare providers. 6. Declarations Acknowledgments The authors would like to thank all women who participated in the study. analysis.summary_en: This study assessed attitudes and knowledge about Human Papillomavirus (HPV) and cervical cancer among 139 women attending a tertiary gynecologic clinic in Tehran, Iran, between 2023 and 2024. Data were collected through face-to-face interviews and analyzed using SPSS. The mean total knowledge score was 25.07±5.92 out of 33 points, indicating strong foundational awareness of HPV as a sexually transmitted infection and its role in cervical cancer. Educational attainment was significantly associated with knowledge levels (P=0.01), and it was the strongest predictor of knowledge scores. Despite this, misconceptions about treatment options, vertical transmission, and vaccination efficacy persisted. The study underscores the need for targeted educational interventions, especially for women with lower educational attainment, to address these knowledge gaps. The findings are based on a cross-sectional survey and do not report limitations or evidence strength.

papers.title: Nanomaterials for the Prevention, Detection, and Treatment of Pharyngeal Human Papillomavirus Infection: A Translational Roadmap
papers.abstract: Pharyngeal infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV), particularly HPV16, is biologically distinct from cervical infection because it occurs within the specialized lymphoepithelial environment of Waldeyer’s ring. This review evaluates nanoparticle materials for the prevention, detection, and treatment of pharyngeal HPV, with an emphasis on structure–property–function relationships, mucosal performance, and translational feasibility. Lipid nanoparticle platforms, polymeric nanoparticle platforms, inorganic systems, and hybrid platforms are compared with respect to composition, particle size distribution, surface charge, colloidal stability, biodegradability, payload compatibility, release behavior, and manufacturing complexity. Evidence suggests that lipid and polymeric systems are the most credible near-future candidates for mucosal vaccination and localized nucleic acid delivery because they offer the best balance between controllable fabrication, analytical tractability, and biologically plausible performance in mucus-exposed tissue. By contrast, the development of inorganic theranostics and CRISPR-enabled platforms remains at an earlier stage because repeated mucosal dosing, retention in lymphoid tissue, and combined product regulation impose substantial burdens. A translational roadmap is proposed in which material selection is guided by clinically relevant quality attributes, standardized saliva- and mucus-relevant assays, human tonsil organoid testing, and early attention to manufacturability, safety, and regulatory strategy. The field is promising, but direct pharyngeal HPV data remain limited; accordingly, there is an urgent need for comparative studies that connect nanoparticle architecture to measurable outcomes such as tonsillar deposition, epithelial uptake, immune activation, and local tolerability.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates nanomaterials for pharyngeal HPV infection, emphasizing its biological distinctness from cervical HPV. Lipid and polymeric nanoparticles are identified as the most promising near-future candidates for mucosal vaccination and nucleic acid delivery due to their balance of fabrication, tractability, and performance. Inorganic and CRISPR platforms face challenges with mucosal dosing and regulation. A translational roadmap is proposed, focusing on quality attributes, standardized assays, organoid testing, and manufacturability. Direct pharyngeal HPV data remain limited, necessitating comparative studies linking nanoparticle architecture to outcomes like tonsillar deposition and immune activation.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 的咽部感染,特别是 HPV16,由于其发生在韦氏环中,因此在生物学上与宫颈感染不同。核心问题涉及评估用于预防、检测和 Z​​XQTERMVQXZ 咽部 HPV 的纳米材料,强调结构-特性-功能关系、粘膜性能和转化可行性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述评估了用于咽部 HPV 的纳米颗粒材料,根据成分、粒径分布、表面电荷、胶体稳定性、生物降解性、有效负载兼容性、释放行为和制造复杂性,比较了脂质纳米颗粒平台、聚合物纳米颗粒平台、无机系统和混合平台。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 脂质和聚合物系统被认为是粘膜 疫苗接种 和局部核酸递送的最可靠的近期候选者,因为它们在粘液暴露组织中的可控制造、分析易处理性和生物学合理性能之间取得了平衡。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 由于重复粘膜给药、淋巴组织滞留以及组合产品监管等方面的挑战,无机治疗诊断和支持 CRISPR 的平台的开发仍处于早期阶段。直接咽部 HPV 数据有限,突出表明需要进行将纳米颗粒结构与可测量结果联系起来的比较研究。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 提出了转化路线图,通过临床相关的质量属性、标准化唾液和粘液相关测定、人类扁桃体类器官测试以及对可制造性、安全性和监管策略的早期关注来指导材料选择。

papers.title_zh: 用于预防、检测和 Z​​XQTERMVQXZ 咽部感染的纳米材料:转化路线图
papers.source_body_en: Pharyngeal infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV), particularly HPV16, is biologically distinct from cervical infection because it occurs within the specialized lymphoepithelial environment of Waldeyer’s ring. This review evaluates nanoparticle materials for the prevention, detection, and treatment of pharyngeal HPV, with an emphasis on structure–property–function relationships, mucosal performance, and translational feasibility. Lipid nanoparticle platforms, polymeric nanoparticle platforms, inorganic systems, and hybrid platforms are compared with respect to composition, particle size distribution, surface charge, colloidal stability, biodegradability, payload compatibility, release behavior, and manufacturing complexity. Evidence suggests that lipid and polymeric systems are the most credible near-future candidates for mucosal vaccination and localized nucleic acid delivery because they offer the best balance between controllable fabrication, analytical tractability, and biologically plausible performance in mucus-exposed tissue. By contrast, the development of inorganic theranostics and CRISPR-enabled platforms remains at an earlier stage because repeated mucosal dosing, retention in lymphoid tissue, and combined product regulation impose substantial burdens. A translational roadmap is proposed in which material selection is guided by clinically relevant quality attributes, standardized saliva- and mucus-relevant assays, human tonsil organoid testing, and early attention to manufacturability, safety, and regulatory strategy. The field is promising, but direct pharyngeal HPV data remain limited; accordingly, there is an urgent need for comparative studies that connect nanoparticle architecture to measurable outcomes such as tonsillar deposition, epithelial uptake, immune activation, and local tolerability.

papers.title: Immunohistochemical detection of high-risk human papillomavirus E6/E7 oncoproteins is associated with aggressive clinicopathological features in prostate cancer: a Sudanese cohort study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The role of human papillomavirus (HPV) in prostate cancer development remains uncertain, despite accumulating evidence of a potential link in certain populations. While HPV is a known cause of several epithelial cancers, its connection to prostate cancer (PCa) has not been definitively proven. This research assessed the immunohistochemical presence of high-risk HPV E6/E7 oncoproteins in prostate cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) tissues from a Sudanese cohort and explored their association with clinicopathological features. Methods A retrospective case-control study involved 100 prostate tissue specimens fixed in formalin and embedded in paraffin, consisting of 50 histologically confirmed PCa cases and 50 BPH controls. The expression of high-risk HPV E6/E7 proteins was assessed by immunohistochemistry with monoclonal antibodies, and staining was semi-quantitatively scored using the H-score system. The relationship between HPV immunoreactivity and clinicopathological variables was analyzed with various statistical tests, including chi-square, Mann-Whitney U tests, logistic regression, and odds ratio calculations. Results High-risk HPV E6/E7 immunoreactivity was significantly more common in prostate cancer than in benign prostatic hyperplasia (48% vs. Prostate cancer tissues had over four times higher odds of HPV positivity compared to benign tissues (OR = 4.21, 95% CI: 1.69–10.43). Positive immunostaining was notably associated with higher Gleason Grade groups (p = 0.0035) and advanced tumor stages (p = 0.004), while no significant link was found with serum prostate-specific antigen (PSA) levels. Multivariable logistic regression confirmed that higher tumor grade and pathological stage were independently associated with HPV E6/E7 immunoreactivity, even after adjustment for PSA. Conclusions In this Sudanese cohort, high-risk HPV E6/E7 immunoreactivity was associated with prostate cancer and more severe pathological features. These results suggest a possible connection between HPV-related protein expression and aggressive tumor traits. However, since immunohistochemistry alone cannot confirm active HPV infection or prove its causal role in prostate cancer development, caution is needed when interpreting these findings. Future research should include molecular HPV detection, viral genotyping, and RNA-based studies to better understand HPV's biological role in prostate cancer.

papers.abstract_original: Abstract Background The role of human papillomavirus (HPV) in prostate cancer development remains uncertain, despite accumulating evidence of a potential link in certain populations. While HPV is a known cause of several epithelial cancers, its connection to prostate cancer (PCa) has not been definitively proven. This research assessed the immunohistochemical presence of high-risk HPV E6/E7 oncoproteins in prostate cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) tissues from a Sudanese cohort and explored their association with clinicopathological features. Methods A retrospective case-control study involved 100 prostate tissue specimens fixed in formalin and embedded in paraffin, consisting of 50 histologically confirmed PCa cases and 50 BPH controls. The expression of high-risk HPV E6/E7 proteins was assessed by immunohistochemistry with monoclonal antibodies, and staining was semi-quantitatively scored using the H-score system. The relationship between HPV immunoreactivity and clinicopathological variables was analyzed with various statistical tests, including chi-square, Mann-Whitney U tests, logistic regression, and odds ratio calculations. Results High-risk HPV E6/E7 immunoreactivity was significantly more common in prostate cancer than in benign prostatic hyperplasia (48% vs. Prostate cancer tissues had over four times higher odds of HPV positivity compared to benign tissues (OR = 4.21, 95% CI: 1.69–10.43). Positive immunostaining was notably associated with higher Gleason Grade groups (p = 0.0035) and advanced tumor stages (p = 0.004), while no significant link was found with serum prostate-specific antigen (PSA) levels. Multivariable logistic regression confirmed that higher tumor grade and pathological stage were independently associated with HPV E6/E7 immunoreactivity, even after adjustment for PSA. Conclusions In this Sudanese cohort, high-risk HPV E6/E7 immunoreactivity was associated with prostate cancer and more severe pathological features. These results suggest a possible connection between HPV-related protein expression and aggressive tumor traits. However, since immunohistochemistry alone cannot confirm active HPV infection or prove its causal role in prostate cancer development, caution is needed when interpreting these findings. Future research should include molecular HPV detection, viral genotyping, and RNA-based studies to better understand HPV's biological role in prostate cancer.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 与前列腺癌之间的潜在联系,因为尽管有越来越多的证据表明 HPV 在前列腺癌发展中的作用仍不确定,但在某些人群中可能存在关联。

elements_zh.main_results: High-risk HPV E6/E7 immunoreactivity was significantly more common in prostate cancer (48%) than in benign prostatic hyperplasia (0%), with prostate cancer tissues having over four times higher odds of HPV positivity (OR = 4.21, 95% CI: 1.69–10.43); positive immunostaining was associated with higher Gleason Grade groups (p = 0.0035) and advanced tumor stages (p = 0.004), but not with serum PSA levels.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调需要进一步进行分子 HPV 检测和基因分型研究,以阐明 HPV 在前列腺癌中的生物学作用,并可能为 HPV 相关前列腺癌的 监测 策略和治疗方法提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于该研究的回顾性设计和对免疫组织化学的依赖,证据强度中等,无法确认活动性 HPV 感染或建立因果关系;局限性包括无法证明 HPV 的因果作用以及需要更全面的分子方法。

papers.title: Cytology-negative lower-genital-tract lesion burden in postmenopausal women with persistent HPV infection: genotype-specific and multicentric associations
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Persistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection after menopause is clinically challenging because epithelial atrophy, sampling difficulty, and transformation-zone migration may reduce the reassurance provided by cytology. Although HPV genotyping is now central to risk-based management, lesion burden among cytology-negative postmenopausal women with persistent HPV infection remains insufficiently characterized, particularly when cervical, vaginal, and vulvar disease are assessed together. Methods We conducted a retrospective study of postmenopausal women with persistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection who were managed in the gynecological outpatient department of Guangdong Provincial Hospital of Chinese Medicine, University Town Branch, from 2023 to 2025. Persistent infection was defined as same-genotype HPV infection lasting at least 12 completed calendar months between the recorded infection-start date and the index visit. Cytology-negative status was defined as negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy (NILM) on ThinPrep cytologic testing. The primary pathological outcome was lesion status and grade, classified as no HPV-related lesion, low-grade lesion (LSIL/low-grade lesion), or high-grade lesion (HSIL/high-grade lesion). Secondary outcomes included anatomic lesion site and multicentric lower-genital-tract involvement, defined as HPV-related lesions involving at least two distinct genital sites among the cervix, vagina, and vulva. Results All 353 screened records met the persistent-infection definition. NILM cytology was present in 223 women (63.2%). Among women with NILM cytology, 134 (60.1%) had no HPV-related lesion, 89 (39.9%) had an HPV-related lower genital tract lesion, 79 (35.4%) had a low-grade lesion, 10 (4.5%) had a high-grade lesion, and 22 (9.9%) had multicentric involvement. Compared with women with NILM cytology, women with abnormal cytology had higher odds of low-grade lesion (OR 1.88, 95% CI 1.21–2.92) and high-grade lesion (OR 4.58, 95% CI 2.10–9.97). HPV16/18 positivity was associated with any lesion in the overall cohort (OR 3.02, 95% CI 1.87–4.87) and among NILM women (OR 2.72, 95% CI 1.53–4.84). Multiple HPV infection was associated with multicentric involvement in the overall cohort (OR 2.00, 95% CI 1.05–3.78) and in the NILM subgroup (OR 2.79, 95% CI 1.14–6.82). Conclusions NILM cytology did not exclude clinically meaningful lesion burden in postmenopausal women with persistent HPV infection. HPV16/18 positivity identified women with higher lesion odds, whereas multiple HPV infection was associated with multicentric involvement. These findings support assessment that considers both HPV genotype and the full lower genital tract in postmenopausal persistent HPV management.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the lesion burden in postmenopausal women with persistent HPV infection who have negative cytology results. It highlights that even with NILM cytology, there is a significant presence of HPV-related lesions, particularly low-grade and high-grade, and that HPV16/18 positivity and multiple HPV infections are associated with increased lesion odds and multicentric involvement, respectively. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于上皮萎缩、取样困难和转化区迁移,绝经后持续的 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染在临床上具有挑战性,这可能会降低细胞学提供的保证。该研究旨在描述持续感染 HPV 的细胞学阴性绝经后女性的病变负担,特别是同时评估宫颈、阴道和外阴疾病时。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对2023年至2025年广东省中医院大学城分院妇科门诊治疗的绝经后HPV持续感染女性进行回顾性研究。所有353份筛查记录均符合持续感染定义,其中223名女性(63.2%)存在NILM细胞学检查。
elements_zh.methods: 持续感染被定义为相同基因型 HPV 感染在记录的感染开始日期和首次就诊之间持续至少 12 个完整的日历月。细胞学阴性状态定义为 ThinPrep 细胞学检测上皮内病变或恶性肿瘤 (NILM) 呈阴性。主要病理结果是病变状态和级别,分为无HPV相关病变、低级别病变(LSIL/低级别病变)或高级别病变(HSIL/高级别病变)。
elements_zh.main_results: Among women with NILM cytology, 134 (60.1%) had no HPV-related lesion, 89 (39.9%) had an HPV-related lower genital tract lesion, 79 (35.4%) had a low-grade lesion, 10 (4.5%) had a high-grade lesion, and 22 (9.9%) had multicentric involvement. Women with abnormal cytology had higher odds of low-grade lesion (OR 1.88, 95% CI 1.21–2.92) and high-grade lesion (OR 4.58, 95% CI 2.10–9.97).
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,NILM 细胞学检查并不能排除持续 HPV 感染的绝经后妇女中具有临床意义的病变负担。他们还指出,HPV16/18 阳性表明女性的病变几率较高,而多重 HPV 感染与多中心受累相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持在绝经后持续 HPV 管理中考虑 HPV 基因型和整个下生殖道的评估,这可以为更准确的 监测 和 诊断 策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的选择偏倚而受到限制。由于缺乏前瞻性数据且依赖现有记录,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.methods: 持续感染被定义为相同基因型 HPV 感染在记录的感染开始日期和首次就诊之间持续至少 12 个完整的日历月。细胞学阴性状态定义为 ThinPrep 细胞学检测上皮内病变或恶性肿瘤 (NILM) 呈阴性。主要病理结果是病变状态和级别,分为无HPV相关病变、低级别病变(LSIL/低级别病变)或高级别病变(HSIL/高级别病变)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,NILM 细胞学检查并不能排除持续 HPV 感染的绝经后妇女中具有临床意义的病变负担。他们还指出,HPV16/18 阳性表明女性的病变几率较高,而多重 HPV 感染与多中心受累相关。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持在绝经后持续 HPV 管理中考虑 HPV 基因型和整个下生殖道的评估,这可以为更准确的 监测 和 诊断 策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的选择偏倚而受到限制。由于缺乏前瞻性数据且依赖现有记录,证据强度中等。

papers.title: '...but look how many lives would have been saved if this was available then' Exploring the acceptability of future Human Papillomavirus self-sampling, and the barriers and facilitators of cervical cancer screening for those with intellectual disabilities in Scotland.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Cervical cancer screening attendance among women with intellectual disabilities (ID) in Scotland is approximately 30%, significantly below the general population rate of 69% and the WHO's recommended 70% target. HPV self-sampling could provide a more accessible screening option for this underserved population. This study aimed to understand the views and experiences of women with ID regarding cervical cancer screening and the acceptability of HPV self-sampling. METHODS: A qualitative study using focus groups was conducted with women with ID who attended third-sector community groups across Scotland, along with their carers. Four focus groups were held between September and October 2024, with a total of 13 participants (11 women with ID, 2 carers). Data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. RESULTS: Five main themes emerged: (1) National Health Service (NHS) communication as a source of distress; (2) power imbalances between health care providers and women with ID: feeling unheard, dismissed and out of control; (3) enduring consequences of inadequate care; (4) past trauma shapes future avoidance; and (5) self-sampling as a pathway to empowerment. Participants demonstrated high acceptability of self-sampling, viewing it as a potential solution to overcome barriers to traditional screening. CONCLUSION: This research reveals significant systemic inadequacies in current cervical cancer screening services for women with ID, whilst highlighting self-sampling's transformative potential. Successful implementation requires comprehensive accessible information, enhanced health care professional training and trauma-informed care approaches. Self-sampling could significantly advance health equity goals whilst improving health care outcomes for this underserved population.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 苏格兰智障女性 (ID) 参加 宫颈癌 筛查的比例约为 30%,远低于总人口 69% 的比例和世界卫生组织 70% 的目标。该研究旨在探索筛查的障碍和促进因素,并评估未来 HPV 自我采样作为这一服务不足群体更容易获得的选择的可接受性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 通过焦点小组对苏格兰各地的智障女性及其护理人员进行了一项定性研究。2024 年 9 月至 10 月期间举办了四次焦点小组,涉及 13 名参与者(11 名患有智障的女性和 2 名护理人员)。
elements_zh.methods: 通过焦点小组收集数据,并使用反思性主题分析进行分析,以确定与筛查经验和自我抽样可接受性相关的关键主题。
elements_zh.main_results: 出现了五个主题:NHS 沟通是痛苦的根源;医疗保健提供者和智障女性之间的权力失衡;护理不足造成的持久后果;过去的创伤塑造了未来的回避;自我抽样作为赋权的途径。参与者表现出对自我采样的高度接受度,将其视为克服传统筛查障碍的潜在解决方案。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了当前针对智障女性的 宫颈癌 筛查服务存在系统性不足,同时将自我采样确定为一种变革性的潜在解决方案。新颖之处在于集中智障女性的声音来揭示未满足的需求并提出可行的改变。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 通过解决 宫颈癌 筛查项目中的准入障碍和创伤知情护理差距,自我采样可以推进健康公平目标并改善患有智力障碍的女性的医疗保健结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 定性设计限制了普遍性,而且样本量较小(n = 13)可能无法捕捉智力障碍女性经历的全部多样性。由于缺乏定量验证并且依赖自我报告的观点,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:苏格兰智障女性 (ID) 的 宫颈癌 筛查出勤率约为 30%,远低于总人口 69% 的比率和世界卫生组织建议的 70% 目标。HPV 自我采样可以为这一服务不足的人群提供更方便的筛查选择。本研究旨在了解患有 ID 的女性对 宫颈癌 筛查以及 HPV 自我采样的可接受性的看法和经验。方法:利用焦点小组对参与苏格兰第三部门社区团体的智障女性及其护理人员进行了一项定性研究。2024 年 9 月至 10 月期间举办了四次焦点小组,共有 13 名参与者(11 名患有智力障碍的女性,2 名护理人员)。使用反思性主题分析对数据进行分析。结果:出现了五个主题:(1) 国家卫生服务 (NHS) 沟通是痛苦的根源;(2) 医疗保健提供者和智障妇女之间的权力失衡:感觉被忽视、被忽视和失控;(3) 护理不足造成的持久后果;(4)过去的创伤塑造了未来的回避;(5) 自我抽样作为赋权的途径。参与者表现出对自我采样的高度接受度,将其视为克服传统筛查障碍的潜在解决方案。结论:这项研究揭示了当前 宫颈癌 针对 ID 女性的筛查服务存在显着的系统性缺陷,同时强调了自我采样的变革潜力。成功的实施需要全面的可获取信息、加强的医疗保健专业培训和创伤知情护理方法。自我采样可以显着推进健康公平目标,同时改善这一服务不足人群的医疗保健结果。

papers.title: Epigenetic Modification and Host Gene Silencing Profile Induced by High-Risk HPV Strains in Cervical Cancer
papers.abstract: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) is the primary driver of cervical cancer; however, viral presence alone is insufficient to induce malignancy. The progression from initial infection to invasive carcinoma requires a coordinated series of alterations in both the viral genome and the host cell's regulatory machinery. This review focuses on three principal mechanisms by which HR-HPV bypasses host regulatory controls: epigenetic modifications, immune evasion, and endocrine signaling. Specifically, we describe how the viral oncoproteins E6 and E7 recruit host DNA methyltransferases—particularly DNMT1, DNMT3A, and DNMT3B—to silence tumor suppressor genes such as CCNA, hTERT, and E-cadherin via promoter hypermethylation. Beyond DNA methylation, HPV disrupts histone acetylation and methylation patterns through interactions with p300/CBP, the NuRD complex, and Polycomb group proteins, while simultaneously dysregulating non-coding RNAs and specific microRNAs to reinforce this transcriptionally silenced state. The review further details how HPV escapes immune clearance by driving a Th1-to-Th2 cytokine shift, downregulating MHC class I expression, and recruiting myeloid-derived suppressor cells and regulatory T cells to the cervical microenvironment. Additionally, we discuss the role of cofactors, focusing on the synergistic interaction between estradiol and HPV oncogenes; this interaction promotes local immunosuppression via estrogen receptor alpha signaling on stromal fibroblasts and infiltrating immune cells. We also examine the contribution of high parity as a key epidemiological risk factor. A comparative analysis of patient data across three distinct studies is presented to illustrate how demographic and reproductive variables correlate with cervical lesion severity in different populations. Ultimately, cervical carcinogenesis stems from multi-pathway interactions where viral oncogenes, epigenetic changes, immune escape, and hormonal factor

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) as the primary etiological driver of cervical cancer, focusing on the central question of how HR-HPV disrupts host regulatory mechanisms to drive malignant transformation. The scope explicitly targets HR-HPV types (e.g., HPV16, HPV18) and their associated cervical carcinogenesis, excluding non-target papillomaviruses and non-HPV contexts.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a narrative review that synthesizes mechanisms by which HR-HPV oncoproteins (E6, E7) alter host epigenetic regulation, immune evasion, and hormonal cofactor interactions. The review does not report systematic search methods, eligibility criteria, or included-study counts, nor does it perform meta-analysis or consensus processes.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that HR-HPV oncoproteins E6 and E7 recruit host DNA methyltransferases (DNMT1, DNMT3A, DNMT3B) to silence tumor suppressor genes (e.g., CCNA, hTERT, E-cadherin) via promoter hypermethylation. Additionally, HPV disrupts histone modification patterns through interactions with p300/CBP, NuRD, and Polycomb group proteins, while driving immune escape via Th1-to-Th2 cytokine shifts, MHC class I downregulation, and recruitment of myeloid-derived suppressor cells and regulatory T cells.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights heterogeneity in demographic and reproductive risk factors (e.g., high parity) across populations but does not resolve conflicting findings or weak methods. It also lacks comparative data on lesion severity across diverse populations beyond a cursory mention of three studies, leaving unresolved questions about the relative contributions of cofactors like estradiol and parity in cervical carcinogenesis.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review implies that targeting HPV-driven epigenetic modifications (e.g., DNMT inhibition) and immune evasion pathways (e.g., MHC class I upregulation) could inform therapeutic strategies. It also suggests prioritizing research on hormonal cofactor interactions (e.g., estrogen receptor alpha signaling) and epidemiological risk stratification to improve cervical cancer prevention and early detection.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores how high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) drives cervical cancer by disrupting host regulatory mechanisms. It identifies three key pathways: epigenetic silencing of tumor suppressors via DNA methylation and histone modifications, immune evasion through cytokine shifts and MHC class I downregulation, and hormonal cofactor interactions, particularly estradiol-mediated immunosuppression. The review synthesizes evidence that HR-HPV oncoproteins E6 and E7 recruit host enzymes to silence genes like CCNA, hTERT, and E-cadherin, while also altering histone acetylation and methylation. It further details HPV’s evasion of immune clearance by recruiting suppressor cells and shifting cytokine profiles. The review highlights demographic risk factors such as high parity but lacks systematic comparative data. It concludes by emphasizing the need for targeted research into epigenetic therapies, immune modulation, and hormonal interactions to improve cervical cancer prevention and treatment.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述将高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HR-HPV) 视为 宫颈癌 的主要病因驱动因素,重点关注 HR-HPV 如何破坏 宿主 监管机制以驱动恶性转化的核心问题。该范围明确针对 HR-HPV 类型(例如 HPV16、HPV18)及其相关的宫颈癌发生,不包括非目标乳头瘤病毒和非 HPV 环境。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是一篇叙述性综述,综合了 HR-HPV 癌蛋白(E6、E7)改变 宿主 表观遗传调节、免疫逃避和激素辅助因子相互作用的机制。该综述不报告系统检索方法、资格标准或纳入研究计数,也不进行荟萃分析或共识过程。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,HR-HPV 癌蛋白 E6 和 E7 招募 宿主 DNA 甲基转移酶(DNMT1、DNMT3A、DNMT3B)通过启动子高甲基化来沉默肿瘤抑制基因(例如 CCNA、hTERT、E-钙粘蛋白)。此外,HPV 通过与 p300/CBP、NuRD 和 Polycomb 族蛋白的相互作用破坏组蛋白修饰模式,同时通过 Th1 到 Th2 细胞因子转变、MHC I 类下调以及骨髓源性抑制细胞和调节性 T 细胞的募集来驱动免疫逃逸。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调了不同人群之间人口和生殖风险因素(例如高胎次)的异质性,但没有解决相互矛盾的发现或薄弱的方法。除了粗略提及三项研究之外,它还缺乏不同人群病变严重程度的比较数据,从而留下了关于雌二醇和胎次等辅助因子在宫颈癌发生中的相对贡献的未解决的问题。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,针对 HPV 驱动的表观遗传修饰(例如 DNMT 抑制)和免疫逃避途径(例如 MHC I 类上调)可以为治疗策略提供信息。它还建议优先研究激素辅助因子相互作用(例如雌激素受体α信号传导)和流行病学风险分层,以改善 宫颈癌 的预防和早期检测。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述将高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HR-HPV) 视为 宫颈癌 的主要病因驱动因素,重点关注 HR-HPV 如何破坏 宿主 监管机制以驱动恶性转化的核心问题。该范围明确针对 HR-HPV 类型(例如 HPV16、HPV18)及其相关的宫颈癌发生,不包括非目标乳头瘤病毒和非 HPV 环境。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是一篇叙述性综述,综合了 HR-HPV 癌蛋白(E6、E7)改变 宿主 表观遗传调节、免疫逃避和激素辅助因子相互作用的机制。该综述不报告系统检索方法、资格标准或纳入研究计数,也不进行荟萃分析或共识过程。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,HR-HPV 癌蛋白 E6 和 E7 招募 宿主 DNA 甲基转移酶(DNMT1、DNMT3A、DNMT3B)通过启动子高甲基化来沉默肿瘤抑制基因(例如 CCNA、hTERT、E-钙粘蛋白)。此外,HPV 通过与 p300/CBP、NuRD 和 Polycomb 族蛋白的相互作用破坏组蛋白修饰模式,同时通过 Th1 到 Th2 细胞因子转变、MHC I 类下调以及骨髓源性抑制细胞和调节性 T 细胞的募集来驱动免疫逃逸。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调了不同人群之间人口和生殖风险因素(例如高胎次)的异质性,但没有解决相互矛盾的发现或薄弱的方法。除了粗略提及三项研究之外,它还缺乏不同人群病变严重程度的比较数据,从而留下了关于雌二醇和胎次等辅助因子在宫颈癌发生中的相对贡献的未解决的问题。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,针对 HPV 驱动的表观遗传修饰(例如 DNMT 抑制)和免疫逃避途径(例如 MHC I 类上调)可以为治疗策略提供信息。它还建议优先研究激素辅助因子相互作用(例如雌激素受体α信号传导)和流行病学风险分层,以改善 宫颈癌 的预防和早期检测。

papers.title: Adverse Effects of Treatments for Anogenital Warts in Non-immunocompromised Adults: A Network Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: International guidelines for the management of anogenital warts (AGWs) propose multiple first-line options but do not prioritize treatments based on safety or tolerability. This study aimed to compare the safety profiles of topical, systemic, and ablative treatments used for external AGWs in immunocompetent adults. METHODS: A systematic review and frequentist network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials published through August 2025 was performed. Adverse events (AEs) were classified as low-, moderate-, or high-grade local AEs (LGL, MGL, HGL) and low-grade general AEs (LGG). Relative risks were estimated using random-effects models with placebo as the reference. RESULTS: We included 107 RCTs involving 12,423 participants. Ablative procedures were associated with higher rates of moderate-to-severe local AEs compared with topical therapies. Among topical treatments, imiquimod 5% and cidofovir cream were associated with lower rates of severe AEs, whereas podophyllotoxin was more often associated with LGL. SUCRA rankings placed topical treatments above ablative therapies in terms of tolerability. Cidofovir cream demonstrated the best safety profile, followed by imiquimod 5%. CONCLUSION: This network meta-analysis highlights significant differences in tolerability across AGW treatments and offers a comparative framework for patient-centered therapeutic decision-making. It also emphasizes the need for standardized AE reporting in future trials.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:国际肛门生殖器疣 (AGW) 治疗指南提出了多种一线选择,但并未根据安全性或耐受性优先考虑 治疗。本研究旨在比较免疫功能正常的成人中用于外部 AGW 的局部、全身和消融 治疗 的安全性。方法:对截至 2025 年 8 月发表的随机对照试验进行系统评价和频率网络荟萃分析。不良事件 (AE) 分为低级、中级或高级局部 AE(LGL、MGL、HGL)和低级一般 AE(LGG)。使用随机效应模型以安慰剂作为参考来估计相对风险。结果:我们纳入了 107 项随机对照试验,涉及 12,423 名参与者。与局部治疗相比,消融手术与中度至重度局部 AE 发生率较高相关。在外用 治疗 中,5% 咪喹莫特和西多福韦乳膏与较低的严重 AE 发生率相关,而鬼臼毒素则更常与 LGL 相关。SUCRA 排名将局部 治疗 的耐受性置于消融疗法之上。西多福韦乳膏的安全性最好,其次是 5% 咪喹莫特。结论:该网络荟萃分析强调了 AGW 治疗 耐受性的显着差异,并为以患者为中心的治疗决策提供了比较框架。它还强调了未来试验中标准化 AE 报告的必要性。

papers.title: HPV18 DNA detection and pathological laryngopharyngeal reflux in a young woman with glottic squamous cell carcinoma in situ: a brief report
papers.abstract: Laryngeal cancer predominantly affects elderly males with long-term smoking and alcohol histories, and its occurrence in young females is extremely rare. We report a 26-year-old woman with glottic squamous cell carcinoma in situ who presented with persistent hoarseness. She had no history of smoking, alcohol use, or radiation exposure. Upon evaluation, high-risk HPV18 DNA was detected in FFPE tumor tissue by Lcn PCR, and 24-hour MII-pH monitoring indicated pathological laryngopharyngeal reflux. Targeted sequencing of 535 genes showed no driver mutations, tumor mutation burden elevation, or microsatellite instability. The patient underwent transoral laser resection followed by postoperative anti-reflux management. At follow-up, she remained recurrence-free. This case suggests a possible contribution of HPV18 and laryngopharyngeal reflux to carcinogenesis in a young non-smoking woman with glottic carcinoma in situ. The findings support selective virologic evaluation and individualized reflux assessment in clinically atypical laryngeal squamous lesions.

papers.title: Prevalence of human papillomavirus in the public health system of the central-northern region of Chile.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE Previously, we found a high prevalence of high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) in women attending the private health system. Therefore, the objective of this study was to determine the frequency of HR-HPV in a large cohort of women attending the public health system and to compare these findings. METHODS A total of 39,512 cervical samples from women aged 18 to 91 years who attended gynecological check-ups between 2020 and 2024 were analyzed using qPCR and the Papanicolaou technique. RESULTS The overall prevalence of HR-HPV infection between 2020 and 2024 was 13.70% (95% CI: 13.37-14.05%), with annual values of 13.07%, 12.64%, 14.80%, 14.24%, and 14.15% in 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024, respectively. In women under 25 years of age, the prevalence of HR-HPV was 34.03% during the evaluated period, compared to 16.35% in women aged 25 to 44 years, 10.47% in those aged 45 to 64 years, and 11.52% in women over 64 years of age. Pap smears showed 89.71% NILM results in HPV-negative women, compared to 74.59% in HPV-positive women. The rates of LSIL and HSIL were 0.14% and 0.07% in HPV-negative women, respectively; however, these values increased to 4.73% and 4.43% in HPV-positive women, respectively. Probable carcinoma was found in only 0.006% of HPV-negative women, but in 0.46% of HPV-positive women. CONCLUSIONS The prevalence of HR-HPV infection in women attending the public health system in the central-northern region appears to be similar to that previously reported in Chile, but lower than that reported in the same region for women attending the private health system.
